page.notes: Greek words in the index are copied as far as legible; "Γεαντά" and "ποίησις" are uncertain. The line "Praxis & ποίησις quid differaut" has a doubtful Greek word, and "differaut" may be a printing error for "differant". "Prauitas" and "pravus" are printed as shown. The line "Primae qualitates" and the entries after it in the right column are read from the scan; the right column ends mid-word with the catchword "progref-".
